title: cyclostemon zeylanicus
intro: Cyclostemon zeylanicus, commonly known as Ceylon celtis, is a plant species native to Sri Lanka. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Ceylon celtis include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce pain and inflammation, as well as protect against cell damage and oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids and phenolic acids, which have been shown to exhibit antimicrobial, antiviral, and anti-cancer properties.
